---
title: "Contributing"
---

Some templates and tutorials to help people with interest to contribute with posts/stories/design.

## Adding a page

Place a new `.qmd` (or `.md`) file in the folder of its section:

| Section | Folder |
|---|---|
| Best usage practices | `practices/` |
| Guidelines | `guidlines/` |
| Posts | `posts/` |

A page can also live in its own subfolder, for example `posts/my-post/index.qmd`, next to its figures.

The section list, the navbar link, and the *Most recent* list on the front page pick up new pages automatically. They read the header at the top of the file:

```yaml
---
title: "Short, descriptive title"
author:
  - name: Your Name
    affiliation: "Position, Group"
date: 2026-10-01
description: "One sentence shown under the title in the section list."
image: ../assets/figures/my-figure.svg   # optional cover figure
---
```

- `title` is required. Without it, the page appears in the lists without a name.
- `date` places the page in the lists. Pages without a date sort as the oldest and do not appear under *Most recent*.
- `image` sets the cover figure in the section list. Without it, the list uses the first image on the page, or none.

## References

Add BibTeX entries to `references.bib` and cite them with `[@key]`. End the page with:

```markdown
## References {.unnumbered}

::: {#refs}
:::
```

## The CHEAC wordmark

Write `{{{< cheac >}}}` to insert the CHEAC wordmark in running text or a title.

## Previewing locally

Install [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/), then run this in the repository folder:

```bash
quarto preview --port 4321
```

The site opens at `http://localhost:4321` and reloads when a file is saved.
